title: Build a WordPress Website
description: Plan, build, optimize, and launch a production-ready WordPress website with a clear architecture and maintainable setup.

steps.title: Define Website Goal
steps.description: Tetapkan tujuan bisnis, target user, CTA utama, jenis website, dan indikator keberhasilan sebelum memilih tooling.

steps.title: Choose WordPress Architecture
steps.description: Pilih pendekatan Gutenberg, Elementor, custom theme, child theme, atau hybrid berdasarkan kebutuhan, maintainability, dan performa.

steps.title: Plan Information Architecture
steps.description: Susun sitemap, navigation, page hierarchy, taxonomy, content model, dan alur user.

steps.title: Design System & Wireframe
steps.description: Definisikan typography, color, spacing, components, responsive behavior, lalu buat wireframe halaman utama.

steps.title: Build the WordPress Site
steps.description: Implementasikan theme atau page builder, template, reusable sections, forms, custom CSS/JS/PHP jika diperlukan.

steps.title: SEO & Schema Setup
steps.description: Atur permalink, metadata, canonical, sitemap, internal linking, indexability, dan schema yang relevan.

steps.title: Performance & Security
steps.description: Optimalkan caching, images, Core Web Vitals, plugin footprint, backup, update policy, access, dan hardening dasar.

steps.title: QA & Launch
steps.description: Uji responsive layout, forms, links, accessibility, SEO, backup/rollback, lalu siapkan deployment production.

title: Build a WooCommerce Store
description: Turn a commerce brief into a structured WooCommerce store with catalog, checkout, operations, SEO, security, and launch validation.

steps.title: Define Store Model
steps.description: Tetapkan produk, target customer, region, currency, order flow, fulfillment, dan KPI toko.

steps.title: Plan Catalog & Taxonomy
steps.description: Susun categories, attributes, variations, SKU logic, product data, dan struktur navigasi katalog.

steps.title: Design Commerce Architecture
steps.description: Tentukan plugin minimum, payment, shipping, inventory, email, account, dan integrasi yang benar-benar diperlukan.

steps.title: Design Product & Checkout UX
steps.description: Rancang product page, cart, checkout, trust elements, mobile flow, dan friction reduction tanpa dark patterns.

steps.title: Configure WooCommerce
steps.description: Implementasikan products, taxes, shipping, payment, transactional email, account, policies, dan storefront components.

steps.title: SEO & Conversion Setup
steps.description: Optimalkan product metadata, category pages, internal linking, schema, search visibility, dan conversion measurement.

steps.title: Security & Performance
steps.description: Audit payment exposure, roles, updates, backups, caching compatibility, image load, scripts, dan plugin overhead.

steps.title: Test Orders & Launch
steps.description: Uji complete purchase flow, payment, shipping, email, stock, coupons, mobile, failure paths, rollback, dan go-live readiness.

title: Audit & Optimize WordPress
description: Audit an existing WordPress site across architecture, performance, SEO, security, UX, and maintenance, then prioritize verified fixes.

steps.title: Inventory the Site
steps.description: Catat hosting, WordPress version, theme, plugins, integrations, critical pages, forms, traffic paths, dan operational dependencies.

steps.title: Audit Technical Health
steps.description: Cari errors, broken flows, update debt, plugin conflicts, console issues, database or configuration risks, dan regression points.

steps.title: Audit Performance
steps.description: Evaluasi loading path, images, CSS/JS, caching, fonts, third-party scripts, database overhead, dan Core Web Vitals risks.

steps.title: Audit SEO & Schema
steps.description: Periksa crawlability, indexability, canonical, sitemap, metadata, internal links, structured data, dan content architecture.

steps.title: Audit Security
steps.description: Periksa roles, authentication, updates, backups, exposed endpoints, plugin risk, file access, headers, dan recovery readiness.

steps.title: Audit UX & Accessibility
steps.description: Periksa mobile layout, navigation, forms, readability, interaction states, accessibility, and conversion friction.

steps.title: Prioritize Fixes
steps.description: Kelompokkan temuan berdasarkan severity, user impact, effort, dependency, rollback risk, dan urutan implementasi.

steps.title: Verify & Maintain
steps.description: Retest setelah perbaikan, dokumentasikan baseline baru, backup/rollback, update cadence, monitoring, dan maintenance checklist.
